Executive summary
Meridian is the system of record for mid-market dental groups, running scheduling, clinical charting, claims submission and patient billing in a single workflow. Practices sign multi-year agreements and renew on auto-renewal terms.
The business is a dental practice management software platform founded in 2009 and employing 61 people from its Columbus, Ohio headquarters. Approximately 91% of total revenue is recurring subscription revenue; revenue grew 14% year over year in FY25.
Switching costs are high: a practice migrating away must move eleven years of clinical records and re-credential every payer connection.
